eligibility_reason: Original Figure3 denoising findings are valid first-class reproduction targets independently of improvement. Published scalar/directional results and tested optical extraction/scoring components exist, but original cohort/ROIs/EP alignment, full numerical frequency/prominence profiles, valid replication and a source-faithful computational admission protocol are unresolved. No authentic recording has been prepared or scored by the new optical component.

source_paper.title: Robust self-supervised denoising of voltage imaging data using CellMincer

evidence.locator: Results: CellMincer improves the detection of subthreshold events in real voltage imaging data with paired electrophysiology; paragraphs27–31; Figure3
evidence.supports: Uses26 available simultaneous BeRST/EP datasets for model training as supported by each implementation, then22 activity-selected datasets for evaluation; Figure3 evaluates trace correlation, spectral noise reduction and prominence-binned peak F1.

evidence.locator: Methods: Procuring fluorescence intensity traces and aligning to joint electrophysiology data; paragraphs71–72
evidence.supports: ROI selection uses raw fluorescence correlation and watershed; common EP/fluorescence trend removal, timing alignment and affine L2 fit precede assessment.

evidence.locator: Methods: Metrics for evaluating denoising performance on real voltage imaging with paired EP; equations21–23; paragraphs73–74
evidence.supports: Specifies STFT64/48 noise analysis with high-EP-power intervals excluded; fuzzy-event F1 with strict2-ms tolerance, optimization within±0.2mV prominence, and averaging over prominence bins.
Author format declares5000 frames, one segment, tyx order and500-Hz sampling; it is not an original cohort/split manifest.

evidence.locator: detrend, dejitter, feature_depth and trim entries
evidence.supports: Pinned preprocessing uses polynomial detrending initialized with501-frame median smoothing, disabled dejitter and stated global feature settings; exact figure-level alignment remains separate.

Paper links the broad-dsp-cellmincer-data bucket and CellMincerPaperAnalysis repository. The analysis repository returned404 during this review; published availability text does not establish an executable recovered figure script.

evidence.locator: Figure3 panels a/b aligned traces and subthreshold insets; c lagged correlation distributions; d frequency-dependent residual noise reductions; e prominence-binned F1
evidence.supports: All Figure3 trace/correlation/spectral/peak companions must be retained; one high-frequency summary cannot replace the frequency or prominence profiles.

Printed median correlations are CellMincer0.90, SUPPORT0.91 and raw0.83; PMD/N2S are described as on par with raw, without exact values. Above100Hz mean noise reductions are CellMincer13.9dB, SUPPORT10.9dB, PMD3.2dB and N2S0.6dB. These are source targets, not computed outputs.

evidence.locator: Results paragraph31 and Figure3e; Methods paragraph74 equations21–23
evidence.supports: Reports12–194percent F1 increase over original comparator methods/raw for peaks between0.5and3mV; CellMincer and SUPPORT alone significantly improve over raw in the reported0.5–2mV and5–10mV ranges. Exact original bins, per-bin F1 values and inferential details remain unrecovered.

evidence.locator: Cached official22-item raw TIFF metadata; names, generations, sizes and MD5 fields; paired22-recording population retained by the local components
evidence.supports: All22 saved raw source objects have metadata checksum pins, but neither metadata nor matching ABF basenames establishes payload preparation, historical26-training membership, exact22-evaluation correspondence or original ROI masks.

target.description: Denoise real BeRST voltage movies and recover single-neuron optical traces faithful to simultaneous patch-clamp EP, including small subthreshold events. Preserve Figure3 F1*, lagged/zero-lag correlation and residual spectral fidelity together; stronger TTX-group significance or smoother traces is not improvement.

dataset.description: Original joint BeRST fluorescence and patch-clamp recordings from cultured rat hippocampal neurons, provided through the author data bucket. An immutable source snapshot and exact raw TIFF/EP-file mapping to the paper assessment have not been authenticated; no payloads were downloaded.

cohort.description: The results describe26 available joint datasets and22 selected for discernible activity. The local22-pair inventory and filename-derived cell groups do not establish exact equivalence to the original selected cells/recordings; the article discussion also mentions30 experiments, requiring cohort reconciliation.

split.description: Original design trains the self-supervised denoisers on as many as all26 joint datasets and evaluates22 selected recordings; it is not held-out-cell supervised generalization. Method-specific training membership must be recovered. A new whole-cell split is a useful separate extension, never a comparison to the published Figure3 numbers.

inputs.description: Denoiser training/inference uses raw optical movies without clean targets; global features may use the source-permitted recording context. EP is an assessment and alignment reference, not candidate training input. The original analysis allows grader-side timing/affine alignment using EP, which must be reproduced symmetrically and disclosed.

preprocessing.description: Use original raw-derived ROIs for every method; median-filter fluorescence trend at one second, Savitzky–Golay cubic EP smoothing with51-point window, peak-based temporal mapping, interpolation and affine L2 calibration. Exact ROI masks, correspondence choices and all original fitting boundaries remain unbound. Author500-Hz/5000-frame manifest is verified but cannot supply these missing transformations.

metric.description: Paper F1*: precision and recall use existential peak matches with absolute time separation<2ms; harmonic mean is maximized over optical prominence p′ in[p−0.2,p+0.2]mV. Exact peak extraction, prominence-bin boundaries and undefined-case policy remain unrecovered. Secondary zero-lag correlation and STFT residual noise are retained; STFT window64/overlap48 are sourced, while the EP-power exclusion threshold and remaining conventions are unresolved.

aggregation.description: Figure3c reports median trace correlation;3d averages residual log-power reduction by frequency, including>100Hz;3e averages F1* over prominence bins. Exact cell/recording weighting and bin integration need the original analysis. Do not substitute the local seven-point prominence grid or arbitrary scalar average of these endpoints.

full_panel.description: The registered endpoint is the complete original Figure3 paired BeRST/EP panel: all22 activity-selected evaluation recordings after method-specific self-supervision using as many as all26 available recordings; aligned raw/CellMincer/SUPPORT/PMD/N2S traces and subthreshold insets, complete lagged-correlation distributions, every original residual-frequency bin, and every original prominence-bin F1* value including small and larger peaks. DeepCAD-RT was excluded in this source experiment. Exact original bin identities, all methodwise profile values, recording membership, raw-derived ROI masks and illustrated windows remain unrecovered. The public22-object cache and nine filename groups are not proof of this original panel. Recovered scalar/directional findings below preserve published summaries but cannot replace or fully enumerate the missing original numerical profiles; source recovery must expand the final scalar findings to all original bin-by-method quantities before admission.

permitted_observations.description: Denoiser development uses the source-permitted raw optical recordings and self-supervised recording/global-feature context without patch-clamp targets. The grader uses EP for the original common timing and affine L2 alignment and final comparison, with one raw-derived ROI shared across methods. Both information conditions must preserve identical original optical inputs, method-specific26/22 membership, EP boundary and assessment rules; paper+data+author-code adds only recovered author code. Neither supplied denoised arrays nor printed figure aggregates establish fresh computation, and no new held-out-cell split is silently introduced.

blocking_issues: Original26-training/22-evaluation identities, method-specific training scope and the discussion reference to30 experiments are unreconciled; the22 saved raw/ABF basename pairs do not certify the original selected panel.

Authentic raw-derived ROI masks/seeds/thresholds/watershed decisions, selected Figure3a/b recording windows, EP channel/units/polarity, peak correspondences, clock interpolation and original affine L2 alignment are absent.

Every original Figure3e prominence-bin identity and raw/CellMincer/SUPPORT/PMD/N2S F1* value, and every Figure3d frequency-bin value, must be recovered and represented separately before admission. These reported scalar summaries and directional statements do not enumerate the full numerical profile; no average, range or seven-threshold prospective grid may substitute for it.

Full Figure3c lagged distributions, precise PMD/N2S medians, frequency/prominence integration and original recording/cell weighting are unbound; source numbers are printed targets, not authentic recalculations.

The paper specifies strict2ms existential event matching, prominence optimization within±0.2mV and STFT64/48, but peak extraction, exact boundary conventions, empty cases, original STFT window/boundary/scaling and EP-power exclusion threshold remain unresolved.

The native-roi component emits fluorescence AU for all22 saved identities using a supplied frozen raw-only mask. It has generated TIFF checks only and cannot produce aligned mV or certify historical ROIs/cohort. The prepared-trace scorer uses prospective split/grid/spectral/aggregation policies and cannot presently reproduce Figure3.

The actual source-granular analysis interface, authentic-data manifest and independent verifier cannot yet be frozen for the complete original endpoint; admission_policy is deliberately omitted rather than assigning hashes to missing artifacts.

Recover all original comparator outputs and fresh analysis lineage, including SUPPORT as well as PMD/N2S and raw; existing minimum-method checks and boxcar engineering controls do not establish the full source comparator panel.

Numerical tolerances, independent cell/culture units, sample minimums, confidence rules, source significance tests and cumulative matched access/resource budgets are not justified. No tolerance or alpha is inferred from printed precision or significance wording.

Matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code input/exposure/analysis/output-verification manifests are not available. Author analysis code recovery remains unresolved; original-finding reproduction and improvement each remain unknown.
